Volt Coins are the premium currency of the game. They are used to instantly finish research projects in the [http://cryhavoc.wikia.com/wiki/Research_Lab Research Lab], unit/equipment fusions in the [http://cryhavoc.wikia.com/wiki/Armory Armory], and unit upgrades in the [http://cryhavoc.wikia.com/wiki/Squad_Bay Squad Bay]. They are also used to purchase special [http://cryhavoc.wikia.com/wiki/Crates Crates] in the Store.

Volt Coins, unlike [http://cryhavoc.wikia.com/wiki/Credits Credits], can be purchased with real money as well as a few ways such as completing the objective '''Kongregate to Victory!'''
